about: Researched directions for app-ui-slopless, 5 per preset. Each is anchored in shipped apps from research/real-ui-references.md. Dealt by scripts/deal.py; do not read the whole file into context. Hex values are starting points checked for contrast by `deal.py --check`, not measured from the anchor apps. Fonts are OFL on Google Fonts unless marked.

directions.name: Hero object
directions.composition: One edge-to-edge picture or single object fills the top ~55% of the home screen. Title and the exaggerated key number sit below it, never on it. Supporting rows are dense and small. A sticky bottom bar holds the total and the one accent CTA.
directions.device: the single hero object every screen opens on

palettes.name: Coral on warm white
palettes.proportions: Warm white ground ~80%, ink ~12%, coral accent <=8% (CTA, selection, one highlight). Photography supplies the rest.

palettes.name: Deep green on cool white
palettes.proportions: Cool white ground, ink, one deep green accent used only for go and selected.

directions.shape: Radii by role: images 20, cards 24, buttons full pill, chips full. One low-blur, warm-tinted directional shadow on floating elements only; elsewhere separate surfaces by tone.
moves: Shared-element zoom from card to detail
Exaggerated key number at 48-64pt with a small label beside it
Sticky summary bar with one accent CTA in the thumb zone
directions.motion: Low-bounce springs (damping 0.85-0.9) for spatial moves, fades for colour, numerals that roll when they change.
directions.pitfall: Stock photos of laughing people; text overlaid on photos without a checked scrim; every card the same height.

mac.composition: The collection sits in the sidebar or an adaptive grid; the selected item's detail fills the content column, with the hero picture or object across its top (at most ~40% of the window, so the facts start above the fold at 1280x800). Title and the exaggerated number sit under it, never on it, then dense supporting rows. The one accent action and the total live in the toolbar with a shortcut, not in a sticky bar; secondary facts go in the inspector.
moves: Matched-geometry zoom from grid tile to detail; double-click opens the item in its own window
Exaggerated key number at 48-64 pt beside its label in the detail header
One accent primary action in the toolbar, with a shortcut and a menu command
mac.shape: Radii by role at Mac scale: images 12, panels 10, controls the system's. Grid tiles and sidebar separate by tone, not shadow; one low-blur warm shadow only on the floating hero object.
mac.chrome: Translucent sidebar kept; the palette's ground is the content column's background. System accent for standard controls, the palette accent only for the primary action and the grid selection. Hero art may run under a transparent title bar with the traffic lights clear.

directions.name: Departure board
directions.composition: The home screen is a board: one row per entity (trip, habit, order, account), fixed columns, status as colour plus word, layout identical when data changes. The one item that matters now is expanded at the top with a live countdown or progress ring.
directions.device: the board row and its live countdown

type.data: Chivo Mono for times, codes and counts
Martian Mono for times, codes and counts

palettes.name: Night board
palettes.proportions: Dark ground ~85%, ink, one amber signal for live/now. Status hues only inside status labels.

palettes.name: Paper timetable
palettes.proportions: Off-white paper ground, black ink, one signal green for on-time/go.

directions.shape: Rows, not cards: radius 6-10, separated by a tone step. Status pills fully rounded with the word inside.
moves: Board rows with fixed columns and tabular figures
Live countdown or progress ring in the expanded row, mirrored in a Live Activity / widget
Status as colour plus word, never colour alone
directions.motion: Calm. Numbers tick (numericText / AnimatedContent). The current row expands with a 0.85-damping spring.
directions.pitfall: A fake dashboard of grey bars; rows that reflow when a value changes; status shown by colour alone.

mac.composition: The content column is the board: a Table or fixed-column list of 15-30 rows (one per trip, habit, order, account), sortable columns, status as colour plus word, fixed row heights so nothing reflows when a value changes. The item that matters now is pinned as an expanded row at the top with the live countdown. The sidebar holds the boards (today, upcoming, archive); the inspector holds the selected row.
moves: Board rows in fixed, sortable columns with tabular figures
Live countdown in the pinned row, mirrored in a menu bar extra and the Dock badge
Status as colour plus word, never colour alone
mac.shape: Rows, not cards: 24-28 pt rows separated by a tone step, radius 4-6 on the selection only. Status pills fully rounded with the word inside, at 11-12 pt.
mac.chrome: Standard sidebar and toolbar; the board carries the palette. Keep the Table's system selection behaviour, tinted with the palette accent (say so in the brief). The menu bar extra uses a monochrome template glyph.

directions.name: Exaggerated number
directions.composition: The home screen is one number: the balance, amount or time left at 56-72pt across the top third, one direct control under it (slider, keypad, stepper), then a quiet history list. Everything except the number is small.
directions.device: the one number and the control that moves it

palettes.name: Navy field, hot coral
palettes.proportions: The money screen is a full navy field; coral only on the primary action and the changing digit.

palettes.name: Signal green field
palettes.proportions: Near-black field, one fluorescent green for the action and positive deltas.

directions.shape: Large flat colour fields; controls full pill; no shadows. The number never sits inside a card.
moves: The number rolls like an odometer when it changes
A full-field accent screen for the money or success moment
One oversized direct control under the number
directions.motion: Number roll ~250 ms; selection haptic ticks while dragging; success notification haptic on commit.
directions.pitfall: A huge number with a tiny label as decoration with nothing to do; the number truncated at its widest real value.

mac.composition: The content column leads with the one number at 64-96 pt, the direct control beside or under it (stepper, slider, or the number itself editable in place), then a dense history Table filling the rest of the window. The sidebar lists the accounts, jars or timers that each own a number; the selection's name is the window title.
moves: The number rolls like an odometer when it changes
The number is editable in place: type to set it, arrow keys step it, Cmd-Z undoes it
A full-window accent field for the success moment, dismissed with Escape
mac.shape: One flat colour field behind the number only; controls at system size, full pill on the one direct control; no shadows. The number never sits in a card.
mac.motion: Number roll ~250 ms; a trackpad alignment haptic only when a slider snaps to a round value; the success field fades in and out.
mac.chrome: Sidebar stays translucent; the number's field carries the brand colour, system accent elsewhere. Trackpad alignment haptic only when a slider snaps to a round value.

directions.name: Quiet chrome, canvas as hero
directions.composition: A full-bleed canvas (map, calendar, chart, camera, timeline) is the screen. Content lives in a bottom sheet with two detents. Chrome is near-monochrome, so the one accent means 'go'.
directions.device: the full-bleed canvas the sheet slides over

palettes.name: Black, white and go-blue
palettes.proportions: Black and white almost everywhere; blue only for the go action and the selected state.

palettes.name: Graphite and lime
palettes.proportions: Graphite chrome, one lime accent on go/selected only.

directions.shape: Sheet radius 24 on the top edge only. Buttons either radius 8 or full pill, decided once. No card shadows.
moves: Two-detent sheet over the canvas
One draggable creation affordance with a visible button fallback (Things' Magic Plus)
Accent used only for go and selected
directions.motion: Sheet springs (damping 0.9); the canvas recentres as the sheet height changes.
directions.pitfall: A decorative canvas (a fake map); glass cards stacked over it.

mac.composition: The canvas (map, calendar, chart, timeline) fills the content column edge to edge. Content lives in a resizable trailing inspector (Opt-Cmd-I) instead of a sheet, and the sidebar holds saved places, calendars or layers. Chrome is near-monochrome, so the one accent means go.
moves: The canvas recentres around the inspector as it opens or resizes
One creation affordance the user drags onto the canvas, with a toolbar button and shortcut as the fallback (Things' Magic Plus)
Accent used only for go and selected
mac.shape: Canvas edge to edge, no card frames. Inspector and popovers use system shapes; buttons radius 6 or full pill, decided once. No shadows beyond the system's on popovers.
mac.motion: The inspector slides with a 0.9-damping spring; the canvas recentres as the inspector's width changes.
mac.chrome: The canvas runs under a transparent toolbar; sidebar and inspector stay system materials. Scroll and pinch zoom the canvas (the one place scroll may be custom). System accent for controls, palette accent for the go state.

directions.name: Living palette
anchors: Tide Guide (ADA 2026, palette follows the sky)
directions.composition: A full-screen hour-by-hour (or day-by-day) view of the product's main quantity. The surface tint follows the real time of day or the product's state. The current moment is a marker you can scrub; details sit in a compact list under it.
directions.device: the surface colour that follows real time or state

palettes.name: Sky ramp
palettes.proportions: Ground tint moves along a dawn-day-dusk-night ramp; ink switches to light on the night stop; accent stays fixed.

palettes.name: Season ramp
palettes.proportions: Ground tint follows progress through a cycle (week, season, budget period); one green accent.

directions.shape: Soft radii 16-20. Content on opaque surfaces one tone step from the field; system glass only where the platform itself uses it.
moves: Time- or state-aware palette
Scrubbable timeline with selection haptics
The chart is the screen, not a card on it
directions.motion: Tint crossfades over seconds, never snaps; scrubbing ticks with selection haptics.
directions.pitfall: A decorative gradient sky with no data behind it; a tint stop where text contrast fails.

mac.composition: The content column is the hour-by-hour (or day-by-day) view at full window width: the tint follows the real time or state, the current moment is a marker you drag or step with the arrow keys, and a compact Table under it lists the details. The sidebar holds places or items; a wider window shows more hours, not bigger ones.
moves: Time- or state-aware palette on the content column
Scrubbable timeline: drag it, hover to preview a value, arrow keys to step
The chart is the window, not a card in it
mac.shape: Soft radii 10-12; content on opaque surfaces one tone step from the tinted field. Hover tooltips give exact values.
mac.motion: Tint crossfades over seconds, never snaps; the scrub marker follows the pointer 1:1 and steps with the arrow keys.
mac.chrome: The tint stays in the content column; the sidebar stays translucent so the window still reads as a Mac window. Check text contrast at every tint stop and with Reduce Transparency on.

directions.name: Sticker sheet
directions.composition: Bordered blocks on an off-white sheet, each section owning one flat accent. One hero sticker is rotated 1-2 degrees. Buttons cast hard offset shadows. A bordered tab strip with the selected tab filled.
directions.device: the sticker or label the core object is printed on

type.data: Space Mono for metadata only, natural case
JetBrains Mono for metadata only, natural case

palettes.name: Gumroad-style pastel punch
palettes.proportions: Off-white sheet, black ink and strokes, one accent per section from the set; text on accents is black.

palettes.name: Primary punch
palettes.proportions: White sheet, black ink, orange as the action colour, cyan and yellow as section owners.

directions.shape: 3dp black stroke on every interactive surface; 5dp hard offset shadow, zero blur; radius 0-4.
moves: The squash button: press sinks into its shadow
One rotated hero sticker
Colour assigned by section role, not per card
directions.motion: 80 ms squash; stamp (scale 1.15 to 1, no bounce); firm haptic on press.
directions.pitfall: Soft brutalism (big radius, blurred shadow, black border); random colour per card; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: Bordered blocks on an off-white sheet fill the content column in an adaptive grid; each section owns one flat accent; one hero sticker per window is rotated 1-2 degrees. The sidebar is a bordered list with the selected row filled solid, and the toolbar keeps its standard place with bordered buttons.
moves: The squash button: hover lifts it 1 pt off its shadow, a click sinks it in
One rotated hero sticker in the content column
Colour assigned by section role, carried into the sidebar's selected row
mac.shape: 2 pt black stroke on interactive surfaces, 3-4 pt hard offset shadow with zero blur, radius 0-4: the phone strokes scaled down to sit with 13 pt text.
mac.motion: 80 ms squash on click, 1 pt lift on hover; stamp (scale 1.15 to 1, no bounce). No haptics.
mac.chrome: A noted convention break: an opaque sidebar with a bordered selection, and the system accent ignored (say so in the brief). Keep the traffic lights, the toolbar's place, an equally visible bordered focus ring, and Reduce Transparency.

directions.name: Spec sheet
directions.composition: Lists are tables: rows split by 2dp rules, label left, monospace value right-aligned. Each task opens a full-screen mode with no persistent chrome and a big bordered close button. Colour comes only from content or one signal hue.
directions.device: the spec table and the full-screen task mode

palettes.name: Grey panel, signal orange
palettes.proportions: Light grey panel, black ink, orange only for the live value or record state.

palettes.name: White and signal blue
palettes.proportions: Pure white, black ink, one electric blue for the active value.

directions.shape: Radius 0. 2dp rules. No shadows at all: borders and rules only.
moves: Table-honest lists with right-aligned monospace values
Full-screen task modes with a big bordered close
One signal colour for the live value
directions.motion: Stepped or linear, 100-150 ms. No springs.
directions.pitfall: Monospace for paragraphs; tiny letter-spaced caps labels everywhere; low-contrast greys.

mac.composition: Lists are tables: a sortable Table of 20-30 rows split by 1-2 pt rules, label left, monospace value right-aligned. Each task opens a focused mode in its own window or full screen with no chrome but the traffic lights and a bordered Done (Escape). The inspector is the selection's spec sheet; colour comes only from content or one signal hue.
moves: Table-honest lists with right-aligned monospace values and sortable columns
A focused task mode in its own window, Escape to leave
One signal colour for the live value
mac.shape: Radius 0. 1-2 pt rules. No shadows: borders and rules only. Rows 22-24 pt.
mac.chrome: The sidebar may go opaque to match the sheet (state it in the brief); the toolbar and menu bar stay system. Keyboard first: every row action has a shortcut and a menu item.

directions.name: Dot-matrix instrument
directions.composition: A monochrome instrument panel: the key number in large dot-matrix figures, controls built from dots (a dot ring for progress, a dot bar for level), a plain grotesque for everything readable, one red signal.
directions.device: the dot-matrix readout

palettes.name: Black panel, red signal
palettes.proportions: Monochrome; red only for live, record or alert.

palettes.name: Phosphor
palettes.proportions: Near-black panel, phosphor-green readouts, one bright green for live.

directions.shape: Circles and pills built from dots; full radius on controls; 1-2dp strokes; no shadows.
moves: Dot-matrix key number
A dot-built progress widget that is also a control
Red reserved for live, record and alert
directions.motion: Dots light in sequence (stepped, ~30 ms per dot). Reduce Motion shows the final state.
directions.pitfall: Dot type for running text (Nothing itself retreated from it); decorative dots with no function; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: A monochrome instrument window: the key number in large dot-matrix figures leads the content column, dot-built controls beside it, readable text in a plain grotesque, one red signal. With few items it is a single window with a toolbar and no sidebar. The same readout, small, is the menu bar extra.
moves: Dot-matrix key number
A dot-built progress widget that is also a control (drag, scroll or arrow keys set it)
Menu bar extra showing the live readout
mac.shape: Circles and pills built from dots, full radius on controls, 1 pt strokes, no shadows. Dot pitch chosen so figures stay crisp at 1x and 2x.
mac.chrome: Dark first, light mode still complete. Red reserved for live, record and alert; the system accent is ignored (say so in the brief). The menu bar glyph is a monochrome template.

directions.name: Poster blocks
directions.composition: Each section is a full-width flat colour block with a giant uppercase header cropped at the screen edge. Blocks butt against each other with no gaps. Content inside is plain and black.
directions.device: the colour block each section owns

palettes.name: Figma-ish clash
palettes.proportions: White and black, with section blocks in orange-red, yellow, cyan and green; text on every block is black.

palettes.name: Yellow and pink
palettes.proportions: Light grey ground, yellow as action, hot pink and teal as section owners.

directions.shape: Radius 0. Blocks touch. Hard shadows only on buttons.
moves: Giant uppercase section headers cropped at the edge
A colour block per section
The squash button
directions.motion: Blocks slide in hard (150 ms, no bounce).
directions.pitfall: White text on yellow; a brutalist skin on a generic card layout; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: Each section is a full-width flat colour block in the content column with a giant uppercase header cropped at the column edge; blocks butt against each other. A section list in the sidebar jumps to them and marks the one in view. Content inside is plain and black, capped at reading width.
moves: Giant uppercase section headers cropped at the column edge
A colour block per section, echoed as a swatch in the sidebar
The squash button: hover lift, click sink
mac.shape: Radius 0. Blocks touch. Hard shadows only on buttons. Headers 64-120 pt, body 13-15 pt.
mac.chrome: The blocks stop at the sidebar and toolbar, which stay system so the window still reads as a Mac window. Transparent title bar over the first block, traffic lights clear.

directions.name: Hand-drawn raw
anchors: grug (ADA 2026, scribbled UI and custom status bar)
directions.composition: Everything drawn by hand and fully committed: wobbly strokes on every control and card, scribble fills for the selected state, a hand-drawn tab bar, a paper ground. The layout stays simple so the drawing carries it.
directions.device: the hand-drawn object the user marks

type.display: Hand lettering drawn as paths in code
A handwriting face from Google Fonts (check it is OFL before shipping)

palettes.name: Marker on paper
palettes.proportions: White paper, black marker strokes, one red marker for the selected or done state.

palettes.name: Biro and highlighter
palettes.proportions: White page, blue biro ink, yellow highlighter for selection.

directions.shape: Hand-drawn strokes 2-3dp with about 1dp of wobble. Nothing looks machine-made, including the tab bar.
moves: Boiling lines (2-3 frames at 8-12 fps)
Scribble-fill selection
Hand-drawn tab bar (a noted convention break: labels and 44/48 targets kept)
directions.motion: Boil on illustrated elements; stops under Reduce Motion.
directions.pitfall: Half-committed: hand-drawn icons on a stock UI reads unfinished, not raw; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: Hand-drawn controls and rows on a paper ground in the content column, scribble-fill selection, hand-drawn sidebar icons. The window frame, the toolbar's place and the menu bar stay system. The layout stays simple: one list and one big drawn action.
moves: Boiling lines (2-3 frames at 8-12 fps) on illustrated elements
Scribble-fill selection, and a lighter scribble on hover
A hand-drawn sidebar (a noted convention break: labels, keyboard focus and VoiceOver kept)
mac.shape: Hand-drawn strokes 1.5-2 pt with about 1 pt of wobble; rows 28-32 pt so the drawing has room.
mac.chrome: Opaque paper sidebar with drawn selection, noted in the brief. Keep the traffic lights, the standard menus and a drawn focus ring as visible as the system's. Reduce Motion stops the boil.

directions.name: Toy box
directions.composition: Rhythm, not a grid: one big hero card (streak or progress), a pair of medium tiles, then small chips. Every pressable sits on a darker lip; static panels sit on a quieter base. A mascot in the hero reacts to real state.
directions.device: the toy piece the core verb is pressed on

palettes.name: Sky and grass
palettes.proportions: Sky-tinted base, white pieces, green for the core verb; orange streak, gold XP and blue info each own a role.

palettes.name: Pink pop
palettes.proportions: Blush base, white pieces, hot pink for the core verb; gold, teal and sky as role colours.

directions.shape: Three primitives (rounded rect, circle, rounded triangle), radius 14-20, 4-5dp lips on pressables, 2-3dp bases on static panels.
moves: Lip buttons and lip check-offs that compress on press
Mascot tied to real state
Streak hero with a week row of chunky day dots
directions.motion: The preset's MOTION 7-10 row: squish on every pressable, draw-on check, rolling numbers, ambient mascot.
directions.pitfall: Too polite: white rows with hairlines and one bouncy moment.

mac.composition: Three columns, as Duolingo's desktop web does: a sidebar of destinations; the content column with the hero card (streak or progress) and the lip check-offs in a dense list; a trailing rail of medium tiles (week, quests) that moves under the content when the window narrows. The mascot sits in the hero and reacts to real state.
moves: Lip buttons and lip check-offs: hover lifts, a click compresses the lip, Space checks the focused row
Mascot tied to real state
Streak hero with a week row of chunky day dots
mac.shape: Three primitives at Mac scale: radius 10-14, 3 pt lips on pressables, 2 pt bases on static panels; rows 36-40 pt so the lips have room.
mac.chrome: The sidebar may go opaque in the palette (noted in the brief); the toolbar keeps the primary action with a shortcut. Squish and ambient motion stop under Reduce Motion.

directions.name: Level path
directions.composition: The home screen is a winding vertical path of nodes, one per lesson, day or step. The current node is big and invites a tap; done nodes are filled, future ones outlined. Milestones are landmarks on the path.
directions.device: the path and its landmarks

palettes.name: Meadow
palettes.proportions: Pale green ground, orange for the current node and action, green for done, gold for landmarks.

palettes.name: Lagoon
palettes.proportions: Pale teal ground, coral for current and action, gold landmarks.

directions.shape: Nodes are chunky circles on lips; the path is a thick rounded stroke; landmarks are larger custom shapes.
moves: Path map instead of a list
Landmark milestones
The path draws on to the next node after completion
directions.motion: Node hop on completion; the path draws to the next node; milestone moment at landmarks.
directions.pitfall: A path for a product with no real progression: points for points' sake.

mac.composition: The path runs down a centred column (~480 pt wide) with its landmarks; the current node is big and invites a click (Return starts it); a trailing rail shows today's progress and the next landmark. The sidebar holds courses or tracks.
moves: Path map instead of a list, navigable node by node with the arrow keys
Landmark milestones
The path draws on to the next node after completion
mac.shape: Nodes are chunky circles 56-72 pt across on 3 pt lips; the path is a thick rounded stroke; hover shows a node's title as a tooltip.
mac.chrome: System sidebar and toolbar; the path column carries the palette. Node hop and draw-on fall back to a fade under Reduce Motion.

directions.name: One big ritual
directions.composition: Home is one giant object for today's core verb (a token, a button, a jar), pressed and held with a progress cue. Completion is a layered event. Everything else is stock and calm, a tab away.
directions.device: the one object you press to do the thing

palettes.name: Slate and ember
palettes.proportions: Deep slate ground, one ember orange object; the rest neutral.

palettes.name: Per-habit hue
palettes.proportions: Near-black ground; each habit's object owns one hue from the set; mint for the default.

directions.shape: The object is dimensional, shaded with tone steps, not gradients. Everything else uses stock controls.
moves: Hold-to-complete (<=500 ms) with a progress ring and a tap alternative
Layered success: scale burst, particles, sound, haptic
Several slightly different sound variants, with a toggle
directions.motion: Routine completion under 600 ms; milestones up to 2.5 s, skippable.
directions.pitfall: Celebrating every routine tap equally; hold with no tap alternative.

mac.composition: A compact window (small minimum size) built around one giant object for today's core verb, clicked or held, with Space as the keyboard path; the same object lives in a menu bar extra. Completion is a layered event. History and settings sit in a sidebar or the Settings window, stock and calm.
moves: Click-and-hold (<=500 ms) with a progress ring; a single click and Space as alternatives
Layered success: scale burst, particles, sound
The object, small, in the menu bar extra
mac.shape: The object is dimensional, shaded with tone steps, 160-240 pt across. Everything else uses stock controls.
mac.chrome: Stock sidebar, toolbar and accent; the object carries the brand. Sound variants with a toggle in Settings (Cmd-comma).
mac.pitfall: Celebrating every routine click equally; a hold with no click or keyboard alternative; a celebration that steals focus from the window the user was working in.

directions.name: Illustration leads
directions.composition: Each screen is built around one illustration from a single system (drawn in code from the inventory, or one commissioned set if it exists). Prompts are flip cards swiped left and right; art fills the top half; UI is minimal and rounded; lines boil gently.
directions.device: the illustrated character or object every screen is built around

palettes.name: Warm paper, blue ink
palettes.proportions: Warm paper ground, illustrations carry the colour, blue for actions.

palettes.name: Mint and raspberry
palettes.proportions: Mint ground, raspberry for actions and hearts.

directions.shape: Rounded primitives taken from the art itself; no decorative blobs.
moves: Flip-card prompts
Boiling line on the art
Art that reacts to state
directions.motion: Boil at 8-12 fps; card flips on a spring; stops under Reduce Motion.
directions.pitfall: Illustration packs from different artists; stock 3D blobs.

mac.composition: Each view is built around one illustration from a single system, set beside its prompt in the content column (art on one side, words and action on the other) rather than art on top. Prompts flip with the arrow keys or a click; the sidebar holds the entries. A wider window gives the art more room, never a stretched crop.
moves: Flip-card prompts, stepped with the arrow keys or a click
Boiling line on the art
Art that reacts to state, and to the pointer hovering over it
mac.shape: Rounded primitives taken from the art; radius 12-16; no decorative blobs.
mac.chrome: System sidebar and toolbar; the art may run under a transparent title bar with the traffic lights clear.

directions.name: Persona over data
directions.composition: Serious data shown clearly (charts, numbers, lists), topped on each screen by one line from the app's persona and an abstract mascot shape that reacts. Users choose how cheeky it is.
directions.device: the persona's one-line comment and its mood

palettes.name: Friendly charts
palettes.proportions: Neutral ground so charts read; series colours have fixed roles; pink for the persona and the action.

palettes.name: Sunny
palettes.proportions: White ground, sunny yellow persona and action, green and tomato as data roles.

directions.shape: Radius 12-16; rounded chart bars; the mascot is built from the same primitives as the UI.
moves: A persona line per screen
A personality dial in settings
Mascot mood tied to the data
directions.motion: Mascot blinks and breathes; chart bars grow once on first load.
directions.pitfall: Guilt-trip copy; jokes on bad-news screens (calm those surfaces).

mac.composition: Serious data shown clearly in the content column (charts, a Table, the key number), topped by one persona line and the abstract mascot in the header. The same line and a mood glyph show in the menu bar extra. Users choose how cheeky it is in Settings.
moves: A persona line per view
A personality setting in the Settings window (Cmd-comma)
Mascot mood tied to the data, echoed in the menu bar extra

directions.name: Type as image
directions.composition: A huge condensed headline (64-96pt) cropped at the screen edge is the hero. Chrome is monochrome; full-bleed photography or the product supplies all colour. Below, a strict 4-column grid with one breaker per screen.
directions.device: the word or number set so large it becomes the picture

palettes.name: Newsprint and flare
palettes.proportions: Paper white and true black; one orange-red only on the action.

palettes.name: Lime on white
palettes.proportions: White and near-black; acid lime as a full-bleed field for the hero moment and the action.

directions.shape: Radius 0 for editorial blocks; small radius on controls only; 1dp rules allowed.
moves: Cropped hero headline with tight leading
Monochrome chrome, content supplies colour
Grid with one breaker per screen
directions.motion: Typographic: staggered line reveals 30-50 ms; no bounce.
directions.pitfall: A huge headline with nothing behind it; squashing type with scaleX; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: A huge condensed headline (96-160 pt) cropped at the content column's edge heads the detail view; chrome is monochrome and content or photography supplies colour. Below, a strict 8- to 12-column grid with one breaker, body text capped at reading width. The sidebar lists the drops, issues or items.

Monochrome chrome, content supplies colour
Grid with one breaker per view
mac.shape: Radius 0 for editorial blocks; system radius on controls; 1 pt rules.
mac.chrome: Translucent sidebar and system toolbar; transparent title bar over the hero. System accent left alone on controls.

directions.name: Story cards
anchors: Any Distance (ADA 2023, poster cards, oval mask)
directions.composition: Key moments are 9:16 full-bleed cards, one stat or idea per card, tap to advance, each shareable. Photos sit in one distinctive mask (oval or arch) used everywhere. Everyday screens borrow the card proportions.
directions.device: the shareable card

palettes.name: Duotone fields
palettes.proportions: Each card is one flat field; orange, lime and sky rotate as card grounds; ink is black or white per field.

palettes.name: Forest and yellow
palettes.proportions: Deep forest field, yellow for the stat and the action, pink for one surprise card.

directions.shape: Cards radius 24 (or 0 when full-bleed); one mask shape for every photo.
moves: Story cards, tap to advance, share
Variable width/weight animated on advance
One mask shape as a brand trait
directions.motion: Width or weight animation on advance; numbers count up once; Reduce Motion shows final states.
directions.pitfall: Squashed type and imagery that doesn't integrate (Wrapped 2021's criticism); more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.skip: Tap-to-advance 9:16 cards are a phone form. On a Mac a recap belongs in ed-type-as-image or ed-monogram-grid; share cards can still be exported as images from either.

Cards that show progress state

Rows show progress state; the inspector holds the selected item.

directions.name: Article-shaped
directions.composition: Results and details read like an article: a lede in large serif, an image carousel, a short answer, then sections with sticky headers. No card list. Reading comfort first: 17-19pt body, 45-75 characters per line.
directions.device: the lede: one sentence that answers before anything else

type.text: Source Serif 4 for reading, Libre Franklin for UI
Source Serif 4 for reading, Instrument Sans for UI

palettes.proportions: Paper ground, warm black ink, vermilion only for links and the action.

Sticky section headers
Words instead of icons for actions ('Share', 'Save')

An outline in the sidebar that tracks the section in view
Words instead of icons for actions ('Share', 'Save') in the toolbar

directions.name: Monogram grid
directions.composition: A strict, visible grid (4 columns on phone) of interlocking flat shapes that are both background and container for data and images. One shape breaks the grid per screen. Type sits inside the shapes.
directions.device: the grid shapes that hold the data

palettes.name: Orange grid
palettes.proportions: Light grey ground, black ink; orange, yellow and green shapes hold data; orange is also the action.

palettes.name: Navy ink, coral and apricot
palettes.proportions: White ground, navy ink; coral, apricot and mint shapes.

directions.shape: Radius 0 or full (circles, quarter circles), dictated by the grid. No shadows.

One breaker per screen
Data set inside the shapes
directions.motion: Shapes slide into their cells with a 40 ms stagger.
directions.pitfall: Decorative shapes with nothing inside; random colour per cell; more than two small uppercase labels on a screen (eyebrows, mono caps metadata).

mac.composition: A strict, visible grid of interlocking flat shapes (fixed cell size, so a wider window adds columns) fills the content column as background and container for the data. One shape breaks the grid per view. Hover reveals a cell's value; a click selects it into the inspector.
moves: Interlocking grid shapes as data containers
One breaker per view
Hover to read a cell, click to inspect it
mac.shape: Radius 0 or full, dictated by the grid; no shadows; cells 80-120 pt.
mac.chrome: System sidebar and toolbar; the grid carries the palette.

content_shapes.list: rows the user scans and compares: departures, transactions, habits, messages, settings
content_shapes.number: one key figure that answers the screen's question: a balance, a countdown, a streak
content_shapes.detail: one item in depth: a room, a product, an article, a profile
content_shapes.collection: many items to browse: a grid, a catalogue, a gallery
content_shapes.canvas: a map, calendar or chart that is the screen
content_shapes.story: one moment or idea per screen, in sequence: onboarding, recaps, drops
content_shapes.progression: levels or a path the user moves along
content_shapes.action: one core verb that dominates the screen: check off, record, log
